item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: 2.2X IDPS performance optimization in Azure Firewall
item.description:
Azure Firewall Premium now supports up to 22 Gbps throughput with TLS inspection and IDPS in Deny mode, up from 10 Gbps. It also increases per-TCP-connection throughput with IDPS enabled in Alert or Deny mode to 600 Mbps, from 300 Mbps.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Prepared Image Specification
item.description:
Azure announces a public preview of Prepared Image Specification for AKS workloads that need faster node startup. The feature is aimed at reducing delays caused by repeated container image downloads and initialization on new nodes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: k8s: Announcing etcd v3.7.0
item.description:
etcd v3.7.0 adds RangeStream for chunked range results, improves range/lease/watch performance, and completes the move off legacy v2store dependencies. It also includes protobuf dependency cleanup, Unix socket support, new metrics, and several upgrade-breaking removals.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB is in public preview as a PostgreSQL-compatible database service. The preview highlights autoscaling storage up to 128 TB and claimed performance improvements over self-managed PostgreSQL.

  • Source: Azure Updates
